# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release gets security fixes. Upgrade to it before reporting, and see whether the problem is still there.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report it privately with [Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/newses-app/newses/security/advisories/new) on this repository's Security tab, never in a public issue, discussion, or pull request. Include:

- the Newses version and how it is deployed (Docker or AWS);
- the affected component (server, web app, desktop or Android app, a client API);
- steps to reproduce, and what an attacker gains.

Reports are acknowledged within 7 days. The fix ships in a new release, and the advisory is published with it, crediting you unless you'd rather not be named.

The project site ([`newses-app/newses.app`](https://github.com/newses-app/newses.app)) is reported here too.
